venues.name: & Change
venues.notes: Open only to poets who identify as gay men. Simultaneous submissions welcome but poet must notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Previously published work not accepted. Poems published in pairs with max 44 characters per line and ~65 lines total across both poems. Response: around April, August, and December

venues.name: 32 Poems
venues.notes: Send no more than five poems per submission and no more than one active submission at a time. Do not submit translations or previously published work (in print or online). Response: Usually within three weeks Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

waiver.note: Current subscribers. Free for current subscribers; subscription available via website

venues.name: A&U Magazine
venues.submitEmail: Noah Stetzer Poetry Editor (email address obfuscated as [email protected])
venues.notes: Poetry can be any length/style. Submit as Word or PDF attachment to Poetry Editor Noah Stetzer. Include in email body: name, mailing address, phone number, and short bio (four or fewer sentences). Previously unpublished work only. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: The Acentos Review
venues.notes: Simultaneous submissions acceptable with immediate notification of publication. Previously published material not considered. First North American serial rights exclusive through last day of publication month. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Afternoon Visitor
venues.notes: Submit 3-8 poems in one PDF or Word document, maximum 10 pages. One submission at a time; wait for response before submitting again. No more than twice a year. Include third-person bio and cover letter. Simultaneous submissions allowed, but must withdraw promptly if accepted elsewhere. Previously published work not accepted. Response: five months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Allium, A Journal of Poetry & Prose
venues.ai: AI-generated work will not be considered.
venues.notes: Maximum five poems (up to seven total pages) with no more than one poem per page. Do not submit more than once per genre per reading cycle. Simultaneous submissions accepted; notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Previously published work and AI-generated work not considered.

waiver.note: Columbia College Chicago students. Columbia College Chicago students only are encouraged to submit via email using their Columbia College email address, bypassing the Submittable fee

venues.name: Always Crashing
venues.notes: Currently closed for journal submissions; typical reading period is May 15 - Sept 15. Submissions must be sent through their submission manager, not via email or post. One submission per submission period before hearing back; simultaneous submissions encouraged with immediate notification if accepted elsewhere.

venues.name: American Poetry Review
venues.notes: Send no more than five poems per submission. Previously published material not accepted. Simultaneous submissions allowed but must notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Response: within six months

venues.name: ANMLY
venues.ai: Do not accept AI-generated or AI-assisted writing or art.
venues.notes: Attach up to five poems in a single document with a short bio in the cover letter field. Previously unpublished work only, including work on personal blogs. Simultaneous submissions allowed but must notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Response: about four months

waiver.note: Black and Indigenous writers, and writers of Palestinian descent. Fees waived to support those most targeted by state violence. Also available for those experiencing financial hardship.

venues.name: Annulet: A Journal of Poetics
venues.notes: Submit up to 7 poems per submission with no length requirement. Wait to hear back before submitting again; limit submissions to twice per year maximum from your first submission date. Indicate if work is simultaneously submitted in cover letter. Include name in document or filename. Response: three months (aspirational)

venues.name: Anti-Heroin Chic
venues.notes: Submit up to 3 poems per email to submissions address with $3 fee. Subject line format: first name_last name_genre. Include 75-word max bio. Simultaneous submissions allowed but disclose in cover letter. Do not send PDFs or to editor's personal email. Response: within a month

venues.name: Appalachia Journal
venues.notes: Send 3-5 poems; shorter poems preferred. Simultaneous submissions accepted but contact editor if poem accepted elsewhere. Publishes 6-8 poems per issue.

venues.name: Apple Valley Review
venues.notes: Submit maximum 6 unpublished poems per submission. Preference given to short (under two pages), non-rhyming poetry. Include "poetry" in subject line and cover letter with name, mailing address, email, and short third-person biography in body of email message. Only one submission at a time. Response: approximately three weeks, up to two months

venues.name: Asymptote
venues.notes: Poetry submissions should be up to 10 pages of translated work; if originals are included, the entire document may reach 20 pages maximum. Simultaneous submissions permitted but the journal must be notified of acceptances elsewhere. All submissions must be unpublished translations (source text may have been previously published). Rolling deadline year-round. Response: One month guaranteed from March 1, 2021 onwards

waiver.note: Writers based in sub-Saharan Africa or translating work from this region. Submissions are kept free for those based in sub-Saharan Africa or translating work from this region. The journal may offer exemptions for other regions in future.

venues.name: AzonaL
venues.notes: Submit translated poetry (about 4 poems) with source language versions included in a single .doc/.docx file. Include cover letter and bios (translator, any co-translators, poet—each ~200 words). Provide assurance of translation rights. One submission per issue only; notify immediately if accepted elsewhere.

venues.name: Barzakh Magazine
venues.notes: Poets may submit up to 3 poems in a single text file. Non-tip Jar submissions are free; optional Tip Jar donations ($3.00) are available. The venue notes they have limited Non-tip Jar slots and when full, only Tip Jar submissions will remain open.

venues.name: Bear Review
venues.notes: Maximum five poems per submission in single .doc, .docx, or pdf document. Wait one full calendar year after publication before resubmitting. Only unpublished work accepted; simultaneous submissions welcome with notification if accepted elsewhere. Response: two to four months, sometimes up to six

waiver.note: poets currently or previously incarcerated; poets writing while working only or mostly to make ends meet. Email query to request free-submission link. Good-faith requests only; links limited per Submittable plan.

venues.name: beestung
venues.ai: Do not accept AI-generated or AI-assisted writing or art.
venues.notes: Submit poetry via email to beestung@sundresspublications.com with brief biographical note. Venue is for non-binary, genderqueer, and two-spirit writers. Previously-published work not accepted. Currently closed for general work until December 31st, 2026. Response: at least 3 months

venues.name: Berkeley Poetry Review
venues.notes: Maximum 3 poems per reading period; previously unpublished work only; submit in single document via the link provided (not email). Simultaneous submissions allowed but withdraw immediately if accepted elsewhere. Cap: 3 per reading period Response: 8 weeks Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: bethh
venues.notes: Simultaneous submissions welcome; notify if work is accepted elsewhere. Submit up to 3 pieces in a singular attachment via submission manager.

venues.name: Better Than Starbucks Poetry & Fiction Journal
venues.pays: Up to 12 featured contributors receive $20 honorarium via PayPal upon publication; others receive free PDF or eBook version of issue
venues.notes: Submit via email with subject line indicating category/genre. Up to 4 poems per submission (6 if short forms under 6 lines). Include short bio (ideally 30 words, max 40). Include full name and return address. Do not submit different categories in same email. One submission per category per issue; wait for next issue's call before resubmitting to same category. Response: up to 90 days

venues.name: Big Other
venues.notes: Fee required for most submissions; venue is not a paying market. Simultaneous submissions accepted but must notify immediately upon acceptance elsewhere. Response time within one year. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Birdcoat Quarterly
venues.notes: Up to four poems or maximum ten pages per submission in single document. Previously unpublished work only; First North American Serial Rights requested.

venues.name: Birmingham Poetry Review
venues.pays: one copy of the Birmingham Poetry Review
venues.notes: Submit three to five poems without cover letters. Must include stamped, self-addressed envelope (SASE). Does not accept electronic submissions. If work accepted elsewhere, contact immediately. Response: one to three months

venues.name: Biscuit Hill
venues.notes: Submit 3-6 poems in one document (PDF or DOC), maximum 10 pages, using readable fonts. Include name and email in header of each page. Simultaneous submissions allowed but withdraw if accepted elsewhere. No previously published work including social media. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Black Sun Lit — digital vestiges
venues.ai: We do not accept unsolicited book manuscripts or tolerate AI-generated work.
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 poems (no more than 10 pages) in one .doc or .docx file. For past contributors, wait at least 2 years (online) or 2 issues (print) after work last appeared before resubmitting. Notify immediately via Submittable if work is accepted elsewhere or to withdraw part of a submission. Cap: 100 per month Response: 3–6 months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Bloodletter Magazine
venues.ai: Bloodletter is staunchly opposed to AI in the creative process. Does not accept work written or edited with generative AI; work will be pulled and submitters barred from future submissions.
venues.notes: Previously unpublished work only. Past contributors must wait one calendar year (two submission cycles) before submitting new work. Biannual themed issues; length and style determined by piece needs. Women, trans, and non-binary writers encouraged to submit.

waiver.note: Writers who cannot afford the $3 fee. Waiver available for writers if submission fee presents a financial burden

venues.name: Blue Earth Review
venues.notes: Limit to 5 poems or 10 pages maximum per submission, all in a single document. Only previously unpublished work considered. Submit one poetry submission at a time. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Bluestem
venues.ai:
Not interested in publishing work assisted by or created with generative AI at any stage of the writing or editing process.</aiPolicy>
<parameter name="notes">Submit no more than 5 poems at one time. Current students and faculty of Eastern Illinois University cannot submit; former students may submit after at least five years post-matriculation. Incarcerated writers may submit via USPS.
venues.notes: Response: six months or more

venues.name: The Boiler
venues.ai: Will not accept submissions aided by LLMs (ChatGPT) or AI-generated art tools (Stable Diffusion) in whole or in part, unless submitter notifies editors in cover letter of specific tool used. Attribution to platform required upon publication.
venues.notes: Submit 3-5 poems in one document with cover letter via Submittable (no email submissions). One submission per genre per submission period. Place all work in one document; do not include cover letter or bio on file. Response: 8-12 months

venues.name: Bramble Literary Magazine
venues.pays: one contributor's copy of the print issue
venues.notes: Only Wisconsin poets and WFOP members welcome. One submission per issue. If accepted in previous issue, wait one issue before resubmitting. Include cover letter with mailing address, poet pic, 50-word bio, and poems in email body (no attachments unless special formatting needed, PDF preferred). No previously published poems.

venues.name: Breakwater Review
venues.ai: We do not accept work generated or assisted by artificial intelligence.
venues.notes: Submit up to 3 poems per reading period in a single .doc or .docx file. Breakwater Review accepts simultaneous submissions but requires notification if work is accepted elsewhere. General poetry form closes when Peseroff Poetry Contest is open (February 15 - April 15).

venues.name: Broadsided Press
venues.notes: Poems must be 25 lines or less (shorter preferred). Submit 3-5 poems maximum. Original, unpublished work only. Editors read submissions twice yearly (spring and fall meetings); inbox cleared twice a year.

venues.name: Broken Lens Journal
venues.pays: No; not currently paying for submissions
venues.notes: Submit via Duosuma only (not email without prior permission). One submission at a time; wait for response before resubmitting. Previously published work (including social media) not accepted. If published with journal in last year, wait until next year to resubmit. Poems up to 5 per submission, max 10 pages total, 12pt Times New Roman, .doc/.docx/.pdf format with author name in filename and header. Cap: 25 per reading period Response: up to 3 months, may be longer

venues.name: Cagibi
venues.notes: Simultaneous submissions encouraged. Only one submission at a time per poet. Resubmit only after hearing back. Does not accept previously published work in print or online. Response: six to eight months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: The Call Center Collective
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 poems in one file (Word DOC preferred or PDF). Simultaneous submissions allowed but notify immediately if work is accepted elsewhere. Sliding scale fee of $3–$10; editorial decisions unaffected by amount paid.

venues.name: The Capilano Review
venues.notes: Submit up to 6 pages of poetry, prose, or experimental forms (PDF or Word). Work must be original and previously unpublished. Simultaneous submissions accepted; notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. International entries accepted. Fee includes one-year complimentary digital subscription. Response: January 2026

waiver.note: Indigenous entrants and those for whom the cost is a barrier. Submission fee waived for Indigenous entrants and those for whom cost is a barrier

venues.name: The Carolina Quarterly
venues.pays: Each contributor receives a $25 honorarium through PayPal as well as one copy of the issue in which their writing appears.
venues.ai: Carolina Quarterly has a zero-tolerance policy for AI. We do not accept submissions that have been generated, edited, or revised by AI.
venues.notes: Submit no more than 3 poems at a time, grouped in one file. Poems must be typed, single- or double-spaced, with full name, home address, and email included. We do accept simultaneous submissions, expecting notification if work is accepted elsewhere. Response: Expect six to twelve months for a decision.

venues.name: Cartridge Lit
venues.notes: Send up to 5 poems per submission. No previously published or plagiarized work. Simultaneous submissions encouraged but notify if accepted elsewhere. Acquires First North American Serial Rights; copyright reverts to author on publication. Response: As quickly as they can manage; appreciation for patience given small volunteer staff

venues.name: Cherry Tree
venues.pays: $20 per contributor and two contributor's copies
venues.ai: Submissions using AI must show significant imaginative or intellectual transformation, include process description, source links, delineate human and AI contributions, and specify AI origins. Work entirely generated by AI will not be accepted.
venues.notes: Maximum 5 poems per submission. Current Washington College students and those who graduated in the past 4 years are ineligible. Previously published work in Cherry Tree requires 2-year wait before resubmission. Simultaneous submissions allowed but notify venue if accepted elsewhere. Response: By end of November

waiver.note: Currently incarcerated writers. No fee waiver mentioned on page; incarcerated writers may submit by mail or email to lit_house@washcoll.edu instead of Submittable

venues.name: Chewers by Masticadores
venues.ai: Chewers by Masticadores does not allow Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI). All content is produced by humans.
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 pieces including poetry via email in Word document or email body. Word count limit: 1,200 words per piece. Include 2-3 line bio (max 50 words) and website link. Simultaneous submissions allowed. Subject line: "Submission – your full name".

venues.name: The Cincinnati Review — miCRo
venues.pays: $30/page for poetry in print journal; $25 for miCRo posts
venues.ai: The Cincinnati Review does not publish or consider work generated using AI or LLMs unless the use is a dual creative-critical project.
venues.notes: One submission per calendar year for each print magazine genre. Current/former UC students, faculty, staff ineligible unless 2+ years removed from affiliation. Contributors must wait one year after appearance before resubmitting. For miCRo: submit up to 3 pieces, poems 32 lines or less. For print journal poetry: up to 5 poems, 10 manuscript pages max. Simultaneous submissions allowed; withdraw elsewhere-accepted poems promptly. Response: Typical response time is six months

venues.name: Clade Song
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 previously unpublished poems as a single Word (.doc) or .rtf file attachment. Poems should be 12-point font; indicate stanza breaks if over one page. .mp3 and compressed video files should not exceed 3 MB per email. Include brief cover letter with biographical note and full contact information (name, address, email, phone with area code). Simultaneous submissions accepted but notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Response: varies Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Cleaver Magazine
venues.ai: Cleaver welcomes diverse human voices, but we do not consider AI-generated or AI-assisted work.
venues.notes: Simultaneous submissions welcomed with immediate notification if accepted elsewhere. Previously published work not considered, though personal blog sharing may be acceptable. Translations welcome with author permission or for public domain works. Submissions reviewed through Subfolio online portal only; postal mail and email submissions not accepted.

waiver.note: Those for whom $5 fee presents any kind of hardship. Hardship waiver available; email to request no-fee submission link with genre category.

venues.name: Clockhouse Literary Journal
venues.pays: one contributor's copy and discount on volume purchases
venues.ai: We do not accept work generated in whole or in part by AI.
venues.notes: Submit up to 3 poems, each as separate submission; thematic units of more than 3 poems submit as one. Each poem must be uploaded separately. Previously published work in CLOCKHOUSE requires one-issue gap before resubmission. Word docs preferred. Include 100-word bio or less. Simultaneous submissions welcomed if withdrawn if accepted. Response: up to four months after the close of submissions period Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Coal Hill Review
venues.notes: Check individual genre guidelines for specific submission requirements. Currently no open calls for submissions on this page. Response: 3-6 months Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Cola Literary Review
venues.notes: Submissions open each fall (check back in September). Past chapbook contest winners available for purchase, but general submission route focuses on seasonal reading period. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: The Columbus Review – Ouroborealis Poetry Prize
venues.pays: Prize pool: $30 grand prize, $10 honorable mention. Both awarded poems featured in next issue.
venues.notes: One poem per file per entry fee. Submit via contest form with file upload. Minimum 5 lines, maximum 40 lines. Previously unpublished work only. Open to writers residing in North America. Multiple entries per writer allowed. Simultaneous submissions welcome but notify immediately if accepted elsewhere. Response: Winners notified in February; public announcement March 1, 2027.

venues.name: A Common Well Journal
venues.notes: Send no more than 5 poems in no more than 7 pages; exceptions for longer poems and sequences. Poems must be previously unpublished. No AI-generated or AI-assisted material. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Compassiviste Publishing
venues.notes: Poetry accepted for quarterly anthology. Submit work with brief author bio. Submissions close August 28th (stated as 2026, but treating as recurring annual deadline). Multiple content types accepted (stories, essays, poetry, photography, digital artwork).

venues.name: The Cortland Review
venues.notes: Submit up to 5 poems per submission. Simultaneous submissions accepted; notify immediately if work is placed elsewhere. All submissions must be previously unpublished. Do not use all-caps poem titles; left-justify and use 12-point font. Response: 3-4 months

venues.name: Cotton Xenomorph
venues.notes: This is a special series call for manifestos (six rules plus explanations). Manifestos do not count toward the one submission per month rule. Past contributors may submit regardless of the three-month wait time between acceptances. Include contributor bio in third person (less than 300 words) in email body. Fee not stated on their page; check before paying.

venues.name: Cream City Review
venues.pays: Free subscription of 2 different issues beginning with the issue in which work appears
venues.ai: Cream city review does not accept any piece in which generativeAI or LLM models were used at any point in the creative process. Permanent ban if discovered.
venues.notes: Submit 5 poems in a single file (.doc, .docx, or PDF). No length restrictions per poem. No more than one submission per submission period. Wait at least 2 years before submitting again as a former contributor. Current UWM students and alumni who graduated in past two years are not eligible. Simultaneous submissions acceptable if CCR is notified at submission time; withdraw through Submittable if accepted elsewhere. Response: 4-7 months typically, up to 7 months
